items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: "Gilda was a dancer, and this was what they told me... we want you to do Gilda Gray's life... I didn't know, 'Let's Start the New Year Right.'"

ctx.x: I know the name but I don't remember her.

Gilda was a dancer, and this was what they told me, said, "We want you to do -- we're going to do Gilda Gray's life and we want you to do a number to bring her on, you know, and we want you to do, "Let's Start the New Year Right." Well, I didn't know, "Let's Start the New Year Right." I didn't even know it, but I learned it, and I think I even forgot some of the words that night, I was so excited.

I had no idea that this was going to happen, and funny, you know, this was on New Years night. It was on New Years night, now, and I was so excited. Well, I was excited over the idea that I was going to do this, becuase it was the first time on national TV, you know. And this was the thing that I was really excited over, the fact that I was going to do this on national TV.
